alternatives_rejected.why: Its own span self-time stayed flat at 0.2ms, and the inbound slowdown is only on calls from checkoutservice (E2). Its high latency-90 in E1 is what the caller sees, not emailservice's own processing.
Shippingservice is one of six checkoutservice callees that all slowed by the same ~200ms (E3). A shared slowdown across every callee points to the caller's network, not a fault in shippingservice.

proposed_fix.description: Check the checkoutservice pod's network interface for an injected delay rule (for example a tc netem qdisc) and remove it. Then confirm checkoutservice latency-50/90 and its outbound call latency return to baseline (about 3-4ms p50). If the rule cannot be found, restart the checkoutservice pod as a fallback.
